description: Converts document object transforms to and from DrawingML transforms.

members.name: ReadFlip
members.description: Reads horizontal and vertical flip flags from the first picture transform in a drawing.

members.name: ReadRotation
members.description: Reads rotation in degrees from the first picture transform in a drawing.

members.name: ToRotation
members.description: Converts degrees to a DrawingML rotation value.

members.name: ToTransform2D
members.description: Creates an a:xfrm element with dimensions, rotation, and flip flags.
